title: Got an iPhone Duo? These 9 settings make it easier to use
summary: From Touch ID shortcuts to smarter volume buttons and camera tricks, these tweaks make Apple's foldable iPhone easier to use every day.
llm_summary: If you’ve upgraded to the iPhone Duo, a handful of hidden tweaks can make the foldable feel far more intuitive. By customizing Touch ID shortcuts, assigning smart actions to the volume keys, and unlocking hidden camera modes, you’ll speed up everyday tasks and get the most out of the device’s unique form factor. These nine simple settings turn the Duo into a smoother, more efficient companion for work and play.
